external_product.name: Autodesk AutoCAD 1.0 for Artemis/AIONix
external_product.description: Autodesk-owned 2D CAD for Artemis and Artemis PRO running AIONix. It provides typed coordinate entry, validated numerical geometry, a dual-display command/status and 800×600 drawing workspace, explicit Logix Mouse integration, professional line/blit acceleration, drawing exchange and supported pen-plotter output. Logix supplies funded development support, hardware, distribution and joint marketing; Autodesk retains software ownership and its cross-platform business.

external_product.name: BPI client-server package
external_product.description: BPI’s networked business-application package combines an Artemis PRO/AIONix server with AIONix and CP/M clients. Thin clients send bounded business operations; database queries, validation, accounting posting and transactions execute on the server. Authentication, locking, backup and crash-recovery qualification govern supported configurations. The package definition supplies the three implementation editions with a package licence document and packaging; it does not specify a new per-seat licence policy.

The suite covers general accounting, accounts receivable/payable, inventory control and payroll, using AION C, Logix TUI and a relational base engine. BPI owns licensing, updates and specialist support; Logix distribution and AION engineering assistance do not transfer ownership. Selected balances or monthly totals can be exported for Abacus planning through a versioned disk file; this is not a live database link.

external_product.name: DRI CP/M with Platform Extensions — Aurelia software
external_product.description: DRI-owned CP/M 1.4-derived software with the Aurelia platform extensions, supporting Aurelia and Aurelia+. It combines CP/M application/file services with text-mode TUI, smart-device/FlexiBUS integration, XIP cartridge support and named user areas. DRI owns the resulting CP/M version and its software enhancements and licenses it non-exclusively. The Logix-produced physical ROM cartridge is a separate offering and device. AION develops and delivers the TUI implementation to DRI under the three-party agreement, retaining cross-platform reuse rights. Logix supplies boot firmware and hardware drivers.

specification.description: DRI retains ownership and non-exclusive licensing rights.

external_product.name: DRI portable CP/M Platform Extensions
external_product.description: Optional, documented CP/M Platform Extensions for non-Logix manufacturers, covering text-mode TUI, capability discovery and FlexiBUS adapters. Implementations require host-specific integration and qualification; this software offering does not imply delivery of the Aurelia ROM cartridge or an identical binary image to other manufacturers. DRI may adapt and distribute the accepted AION-developed CP/M TUI under the three-party development agreement; each external host requires its own driver integration and qualification.

external_product.name: SSG General Ledger — vanilla CP/M / CBASIC edition
external_product.description: SSG’s independently published General Ledger for ordinary 8080/Z80 CP/M systems, released on 15 January 1978. CBASIC compiles source to intermediate code executed by its runtime interpreter; this is not native Z80 compilation. The accounting environment provides 14-digit arithmetic. The exact General Ledger revision, CBASIC compiler revision and runtime revision are unspecified. It needs no Aurelia ROM TUI and remains a separately maintained product and the functional reference for the Aurelia port.

specification.description: SSG publishes, licenses and supports the original CBASIC application.
